node.statement: F2 L-FUNCTION DIAGONALIZATION (2026-07-10, campaign cycle 79; digest F2_LFUNC_DIAGONALIZATION_PASS): the summit's deviation field diagonalizes EXACTLY in Dirichlet L-values at s=1. For odd prime p and G <= (Z/p)^x of index m with |G| = f even, the field S(t) = sum_{g in G} log|1+zeta_p^{tg}| satisfies, POINTWISE FOR EVERY t: S(t) = (fp/(p-1)) * sum over the m-1 nontrivial quotient characters chi of (1-chi(2)) * (L(1,chi)/tau(chi)) * chi(t). Proof: (i) multiplicative Fourier + orthogonality kills all characters nontrivial on G; (ii) 1+x=(1-x^2)/(1-x) factors each coefficient as (chi(2)-1)*a_chi(log|1-zeta^s|); (iii) the classical even-character evaluation sum_a conj(chi)(a) log|1-zeta^a| = -p L(1,chi)/tau(chi) (Washington, Cyclotomic Fields, Thm 4.9 shape; numerically confirmed against independent partial-sum L(1,chi) at p=97,257, all quotient characters, err < 1e-6). COROLLARIES: (a) second moment sum_t S(t)^2 = (f^2 p/(p-1)) sum_chi |1-chi(2)|^2 |L(1,chi)|^2 — the summit's energy IS a mean-square of L(1,chi) over the quotient character group (supersedes the log #89 Dedekind autocorrelation reduction by full diagonalization); (b) DOUBLING VANISHING: 2 in G => S == 0 identically (2G=G, the two ell-sums cancel; subsumes the index-2 vanishing for p = +-1 mod 8 and explains every accidentally-flat probe row, e.g. (257, m=4)); (c) with L(1,chi) = O(log p) the diagonalization re-derives the ETK-scale bound, so growing-order Myerson is EXACTLY the statement that the L-value-weighted character sum sum_chi (1-chi(2))(L(1,chi)/tau(chi))chi(t) exhibits square-root cancellation in m uniformly in t — a STANDARD-FORM object of analytic number theory (character sums with L-value weights; Chowla/class-number circle). Verified: pointwise reconstruction, factorization, second moment at (97,m=3),(257,m=4),(7681,m=15) to 1e-10; doubling rows (7,<2>),(73,<2>) flat to 3e-15. Verifier: background/nodes/u2c_giant_tnull_dichotomy/notes/f2_lfunc_diagonalization_check.py. Sixteenth satellite; the summit's interior is now a NAMED ANT OBJECT.
